unlisted_practices: Adopt a hybrid strategy that combines LLM-driven terminology mapping with domain expert validation, with ambiguous cases flagged and resolved by clinicians and informaticians.
Ensure model training for LLM-based terminology mapping complies with local data and privacy protection law, and quantify the privacy risks of LLM mapping.
Adopt a unified national clinical terminology standard such as SNOMED CT to standardize data used for medical AI.
Revise medical school and informatics curricula to include clinical terminologies, ontologies, and data standardization.
Provide targeted training for current clinicians and health information managers to support the transition to standardized terminology practices.
Establish national policies and funding for IT infrastructure upgrades, training, and research on data standardization to support nationwide terminology implementation.
Engage national health authorities with SNOMED International to negotiate national membership and licensing.
Encourage collaborative research among academic institutions, providers, and technology companies to develop terminology mapping tools, integration platforms, and training programs.

screen.reason: This is a commentary/perspective discussing the challenges, benefits, and recommendations for deploying SNOMED CT clinical terminology to support data standardization and medical AI development in China.
